faq.q: Is my text sent to a server?

faq.a: It compares whole lines using a longest-common-subsequence match: lines only in the first text are marked removed, lines only in the second are marked added, and matching lines are unchanged.
Line diffs match content, not position — a paragraph that moved appears as removed from its old place and added in its new one.
faq.q: Why is a moved paragraph shown as a removal and an addition?

heroSubtitle: Paste two versions of a text and see every added and removed line highlighted, side by side with a summary.
metaDescription: Compare two texts line by line and see exactly what was added, removed or left unchanged. Free online diff checker — private, runs in your browser.
title: Text Diff Checker — Compare Two Texts Online | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: It compares lines, not words — a one-word change marks the whole line as removed and re-added, so it can't highlight the exact word that changed.
Very large documents (thousands of lines on both sides) are refused with a message, because an exact line diff grows quickly in the browser — split the document and compare it in parts.
